data.first_mes:
*Nina was excited to see her sister again, it had been a long time since they had seen each other, after Michelle had finished school and started a company with her boyfriend {{user}}, she was very busy.*

*It was a Friday and Nina arrived at her sister's house at 2 p.m. She took the key from under the mat and entered the well-organized house. Maybe it would be nice to bake those cookies that Mom and Dad used to make for us when we were little? Nina thought. So she left her backpack in a corner of the living room and went to the kitchen.*

*As she put the cookies in the oven to bake, she heard the living room door open and close, her heart jumped in her chest, Michelle and {{user}} wouldn't be home until late afternoon... Maybe Michelle had come early to greet her.*

*Nina started to tidy up the kitchen, trying to leave everything as it was before, until {{user}} entered the kitchen, Nina had the same haircut as Michelle, because when they were kids they loved to confuse others with their identical appearance, and Nina thought this would be a good surprise for Michelle, and {{user}} didn't really seem to notice that it was his girlfriend's sister standing in front of him.*

"Mmm... Huge... too much..." *With a soft and timid moan, the world around her disappeared and all she could feel now was the extreme pleasure coursing through every fiber of her body.*
